headline: Saturday 3-fold: Villa v Brentford, Sunderland v Brighton, Man Utd v Spurs
summary: Double chances on the sides in better form, with the price coming from a Kamara card and three shot-on-target picks. The main risk is team sheets: four of the six player picks need to be confirmed starters.

result.why: Brentford are slight favourites (about 8/5) and unbeaten away this season. Villa have scored 4 in 5 and rank last in the league for xG, shots and shots on target.

props.why: Picked by bet365, Squawka and Mr Fixit (fouls or booking). He is in the only XI labelled confirmed, facing a Brentford side that presses hard.
Brentford's most direct runner and a selection in bet365's builder for this game.

result.why: Brighton are 3rd and the top scorers. Sunderland are without Ballard and Brobbey and conceded 5 at Man City last time out.

props.why: 9 of Brighton's last 10 away league games had more than 9.5 corners.
Top player pick in the previews at around +115; takes set pieces and shoots from range.

result.why: Spurs are 19th on 2 points with a -6 goal difference and no Porro; van de Ven and van Hecke carry knocks. United are 4/6 to win.

props.why: United's busiest shooter (11 attempts in the first two games) and on set pieces and penalties; 8 shots in this fixture last season.
Racing Post's best player bet at 10/11; Spurs' main outlet against a stand-in left side with Dorgu out.

safer.change: Swap the Kamara card for Kamara 1+ foul, and Over 8.5 corners for Brighton to win the corner count.

bigger.change: Swap Man Utd or Draw for Man Utd to win (4/6) and add Lisandro Martínez to be carded.

left_out.reason: Kicked off at 12:30, before this acca was posted.
Palmer, Caicedo and João Pedro all doubtful, so player picks are guesswork.
